description:

Organization Context


Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.

  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABFL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABFL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABFL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

  

Job Context


Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.

  

The front\-end (tele\-collections) team is the first line of defence against bad loans and write\-offs as it works towards resolution in cases where probability of default is the least (i.e. B1 where accounts are 1\-30 days delinquent). By ensuring resolution and normalization at this stage, huge cost\-savings can be driven for the business. This team will manage front\-end collections for all secured and unsecured retail products. The FE team will work closely with Collections Strategy on Automation, AI\-models (Man\-Machine allocations) which will help optimise costs by 30%. The model is based largely around Tele\-Collections Centres, with most of the cases getting resolved through them. For balance cases, field agencies may be employed where necessary to ensure collection.

 **Achieve financial goals:** Delivering superior financial performance while minimizing potential losses.

  

* Monitor and Control delinquency and minimize credit losses for retail products.
* Drive higher resolution rates. Consolidation of Front\-End would lead to better focus and delivery of targets – 200\-300 basis points improvement in Front\-End Resolutions
* Ensure Charge offs are minimized and higher recoveries from charge\-off accounts.
* Review, maintain control and minimize the cost incurred towards collections of dues.
* Daily monitoring and regular reviews of delinquent portfolio to make location level strategy effectively give directions and to have smooth operations at all locations Pan India.
 **Portfolio Review and Monitoring:** Delinquency portfolio tracking MISs and digitization of collections processes.

  

* Provide regular inputs to Management and all the other stakeholders such as Sales, Risk, Policy Team on various aspects of collections resolution and delinquency trends, Negative Areas, Negative Profile, Non\-Starters, SKIPs, Fraud Cases and other collections risk aspects, based on market intelligence.
* Develop a robust MIS system and related processes to automate and manage collection activities
* Continuously improve practices by identifying new ideas and methods, and by benchmarking against best practices and industry standards.
* Developing various MISs to show different cuts and trends in the portfolio which can lead to necessary corrective action by collections team to enhance their performance and shows area of improvement.
 **Vendor Management**

  

* Managing collections agencies; aligning and motivating them for getting the desired results.
* Onboarding best of external channels in the market to get the desired results in achieving overall collections budgets.
* Agency centralization. Identifying large market players with ABFL\-first attitude for recovery.
* Exercise adequate control on collections and recovery agencies.

* Ensure adherence and compliance to the group code of conduct and regulatory requirements
* Plan and implement periodic audits to ensure that all processes carried out at the regions adhere to the standard operating procedures

* Perform necessary check to ensure that unit is audit complaint and adhering to laid down processes when performing the defined role and responsibilities.
* Facilitate internal and external audits; plan and oversee the implementation of necessary corrective action.
 **Customer escalations and complaints**

  

* Identify and resolve operational issues related to customers, vendors (external as well as internal) with the objective of minimizing / reducing escalations to management / RBI / Legal authorities.
 **People Management**

  

* Provide oversight and be a coach and mentor for the team
* Ensure regular functional \& behavioral trainings of team members in collaboration with HR
* Participate in relevant talent management and people development activities to ensure a healthy pipeline and an engaged team

description:
Designation: NA

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The HR \- ER Compliance Manager – Zonal will be responsible for Employee Relations and compliance across assigned branches within the zone for the Gold Loans business. The role ensures adherence to statutory labour laws, company policies, audit requirements, and ethical HR practices. The incumbent must be comfortable with frequent travel to branches for audits, investigations, and compliance monitoring.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


1\. HR Operations \& Compliance

* Ensure 100% statutory compliance across branches (Shops \& Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, PF, ESI, CLRA, POSH, etc.).
* Conduct periodic HR compliance audits across branches.
* Maintain updated compliance trackers and documentation.
* Coordinate with legal and compliance teams for statutory filings and inspections.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR and labour compliance.


2\. Employee Relations (ER)

* Manage employee grievance handling and resolution within defined timelines.
* Conduct disciplinary inquiries and domestic investigations where required.
* Support HRBP in handling misconduct, absenteeism, and performance issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of warning letters, charge sheets, and termination processes.
* Promote a positive employee relations climate across the zone.
* Monitor adherence to code of conduct and ethical standards.
* Partner with Business HR to address Employee issues.
* Oversee background verification and employee documentation.


3\. POSH \& Workplace Conduct

* Ensure compliance with POSH regulations across branches.
* Support IC inquiries and conduct awareness sessions.


4\. Travel \& Field Engagement

* Conduct regular branch visits across the assigned zone.
* Perform surprise compliance checks and employee engagement meetings.
* Be available for urgent ER matters and statutory inspections.

**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in Employee Relations and disciplinary processes.
* Investigation and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong documentation and audit management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the zone.

 **About the Health Insurance Industry –**

  

The Indian health insurance industry has emerged as one of the fastest\-growing segments within the broader insurance ecosystem, driven by rising healthcare costs, increasing disease burden, and a growing awareness of financial protection. Since liberalisation in 2000, the sector has expanded significantly, with 30\+ insurers (including standalone health insurers, general insurers, and life insurers) now offering health\-related products. The pandemic further accelerated adoption, highlighting the need for comprehensive health coverage and preventive care. The industry’s gross written premium (GWP) crossed ?90,000 crore in FY 2024, accounting for over 35 % of the total non\-life insurance market. Regulatory focus by IRDAI on improving product standardisation (e.g., Arogya Sanjeevani), claim transparency, and digital interoperability (through NHCX and Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) has also enhanced consumer trust and industry maturity.

  

The sector is now shifting from a “pay for illness” model to a “care for wellness” paradigm, integrating preventive health management, digital health ecosystems, and real\-time claim settlement platforms. New\-age insurers and insurtechs are leveraging AI, data analytics, and machine learning to streamline underwriting, detect fraud, and personalise customer journeys. Distribution has diversified beyond traditional agents and bancassurance to digital marketplaces and embedded insurance models. With penetration still under 5 % of GDP and significant out\-of\-pocket expenditure (\~50 % of total healthcare spend), the long\-term growth potential remains immense. Going forward, the industry will be defined by innovation, affordability, interoperability, and wellness\-centric solutions that make health protection more inclusive, efficient, and value\-driven.

**About the Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**

  

Founded in 2015 and commencing operations in October 2016, ABHI is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Ltd. (ABCL) and South Africa’s Momentum Metropolitan Holdings Ltd (formerly MMI Strategic Investments). Over the years it has rapidly grown its footprint: covering **22 million\+** lives, operating across **5,000\+** cities, partnering with **20\+** bancassurance alliances and engaging **140,000\+** direct selling agents.

  

ABHI adopts a distinctive “**Health First**” business model — shifting from the traditional “buy and forget” mindset to one of “buy and engage.” The company’s mission is to proactively help customers build healthier lives by combining insurance protection with wellness programmes, incentivised behaviour (e.g., through the Activ Health suite), and digital experience. The core values emphasise trust, customer\-centricity, innovation, and delivering value through prevention and healthy living.

  

ABHI has made tangible impact in the Indian health\-insurance market:

* Expanded distribution capabilities via branches, digital partners, agency network and bancassurance, enabling deeper reach into both urban and semi\-urban segments.
* Established a wellness ecosystem (with products like **Activ Health** and campaigns like **\#JumpForHealth**) that supports chronic\-care management and rewards healthy behaviour.
* Attracted significant investor interest: for example, a **?655 crore** investment by Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) for \~**10 %** stake anchored ABHI’s valuation at \~**?6,650 crore**, recognising its differentiated model and growth potential.

  

ABHI’s purpose centres on making health\-insurance meaningful: not just covering hospital bills, but enabling healthier lives, reducing disease burden, and building long\-term wellness habits. Its vision is to become India’s most desired and innovative health\-insurer, delivering protection with a purpose. Through technology, data\-driven insights, and digital platforms, the insurer aims to simplify access, speed up claim lifecycle, connect with customers seamlessly and provide value beyond conventional coverage.

  

In conclusion, ABHI stands out as a modern health\-insurer with strong backing, ambitious growth, a wellness\-centric philosophy and technology\-enabled operations. Its differentiated business model — combining protection, prevention and engagement — positions it to capture rising demand in India’s health\-insurance segment, while delivering value to customers, partners and stakeholders alike.

**Role Overview**

The **Payroll Process \& Project Manager** leads end‑to‑end payroll and time‑tracking implementation projects across the APAC region. This role is suited for someone who can drive outcomes, influence stakeholders, and translate business needs into scalable, compliant processes.


Although the minimum experience requirement is 4 years, this position is ideal for candidates who have managed **significant workstreams** , demonstrated strong ownership, and operated in a fast‑paced global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership**

* Lead the delivery of payroll and time‑tracking projects—ensuring execution on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Drive structured project planning, RAID management, stakeholder engagement, and cross‑functional alignment.
* Provide clear and concise status updates to leadership, including risks, decisions, and escalations.

**Process Design \& Requirements**

* Conduct business requirements analysis and document end‑to‑end payroll processes.
* Perform fit‑gap assessments to DXC global standards and local statutory requirements.
* Design scalable processes that support operational excellence, global consistency, and compliance.

**Quality, Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure full adherence to payroll controls, audit requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Support change‑management and testing activities including scenario validation and UAT execution.
* Contribute to global payroll quality initiatives, standardization efforts, and process health checks.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to streamline operations, reduce manual work, and automate processes.
* Influence key stakeholders to adopt best practices and global standards.
* Support performance improvements through metrics, insights, and process redesign.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Payroll Ops, HR, IT, Vendors, and country teams to drive coordinated project execution.
* Operate effectively in a virtual global environment with distributed teams and multiple vendors.
* Manage multi‑country communications and facilitate alignment across time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* **4\+ years of project management experience** , preferably in payroll, HR systems, or large‑scale process transformation.
* Experience with **SAP Payroll, Workday Time Tracking, Kronos, Replicon or Deltek** time solutions strongly preferred.
* Experience working with **finance systems or integrations between payroll and finance/ERP platforms** is an advantage.

* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management abilities.
* PMI / PMP / Agile certification is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical, documentation, and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and drive results.
* Strong business application skills (Excel, PowerBI, reporting tools, documentation tools).
* Fluent English; excellent presentation and communication skills.

**Why Join DXC?**

At DXC, you will:


* Lead impactful projects across multiple countries.
* Work in a global, virtual environment with experienced leaders and experts.
* Contribute to a major transformation program that shapes the future of DXC Payroll.
* Influence process and technology decisions that support thousands of employees globally.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in\-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

title: Human Resources Intern - Recruitment
description:
**About the Company**

Samaaro is an award\-winning AI\-powered event marketing platform that helps marketing teams plan, promote, and execute high\-impact events with ease. Recognized by The Financial Express as one of the best MarTech solutions for live events, Samaaro enables brands to automate event workflows, streamline guest journeys, and gain actionable insights across the entire event lifecycle.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve supported marketing teams across Real Estate, Healthcare, BFSI, Technology, and Government to run smarter, more efficient events. We’re backed by leading investors including LetsVenture, Inflection Point Ventures, SucSEED Innovation Fund, Silver Needle Ventures, and The Chennai Angels.

As one of the highest\-rated event platforms on SourceForge, Capterra, G2, and Trustpilot, we’ve built a culture rooted in ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. We follow a flat hierarchy, give people autonomy, and encourage cross\-functional thinking. If you like building, learning, and taking initiative, you’ll feel at home here.

**About the Role**

As an HR Intern – Recruitment, you will gain hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end hiring processes in a dynamic startup environment. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about talent acquisition, and building strong teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in end\-to\-end recruitment for tech and non\-tech roles
* Source and screen resumes through job portals, LinkedIn, and other channels
* Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers
* Maintain and update candidate trackers and recruitment dashboards
* Communicate with candidates to ensure a smooth hiring experience
* Support employer branding initiatives (job postings, hiring campaigns, etc.)
* Assist the HR team with onboarding documentation and basic HR operations as needed

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field, (people on a career break or wanting to restart their career are also welcome)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Interest in recruitment and people\-focused roles
* Good organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets is a plus

**What You’ll Gain**

* Practical exposure to startup hiring and HR processes
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams
* Certificate and Letter of Recommendation upon successful completion
* Potential full\-time opportunity based on performance and business needs

Job Type: Internship  
Contract length: 3 months

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

* Do you have any prior experience in recruitment(internships or job role)?

As the Head of the IT Shared Services and Bangalore IT Site Leader, you will serve as the executive representative for our India operations while spearheading a strategic shift to centralized IT services. * Standardization: Establish global standards, automation frameworks, and KPI dashboards to ensure consistent quality across all IT products

**Experience**

* Total Experience: 15\+ years in IT, with at least 5\+ years in a senior leadership role managing a Global Delivery Center or COE
* Transformation Expert: Proven track record of transitioning decentralized teams into a shared service or COE model

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Role Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer\-facing brands \- Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15\.1 billion and $4\.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion.  

Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units. **Job Overview**  

As part of our Booking Holdings India team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the world’s leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six\-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable and Rentalcars.com.  

We believe that the passion and talent of our people is our strength – it is what drives us towards outstanding performance. We offer a dynamic, motivating and sophisticated work environment. We are eager to provide everyone the opportunity to learn, and develop skills in a truly world leading security practice. Our culture is open, innovative and performance orientated.  

As we are looking to build our People team to drive our strategy, you will be a part of a new and exciting transformation, giving you an unique opportunity to excel and make your impact on the organization. **What you’ll be doing:**  

* Onboarding new businesses within the India organization and partnering with them on the transition from their home location to the India Centre of Excellence.
* Drive Organization Design conversations early on as a part of onboarding new businesses. Helping them arrive at the right org structure aligned with their business strategy leveraging org guiding principles including span of control and layers.
* Educating, coaching and handholding new leaders/ managers about the India policies and procedures, India Compensation \& Benefits philosophy, nuances about the India talent market and the India career levels, etc.
* Lead change initiatives with stakeholders at local \& global level. Be the change agent to set a culture within the business teams.
* Lead key projects for the organization such as Talent Management, succession planning, manager development or any other similar project which is critical to the organization.
* Responsible for end to end delivery and adoption of critical People processes within the respective organizations you partner with (e.g. engagement conversations, performance optimization, implement programs that attract and retain talent).
* Individual contributor who will partner with a dedicated number of leaders.
* Support the (Sr) HR Business Partners in employee relations processes and cases including absence, performance management, disciplinary procedures and outcomes;
* Contributes to the review of existing HR policies, procedures and processes and signals possibilities for optimization, guides operational implementation and execution in own and broader business unit
* Partner with global HR Business Partners to develop a common understanding of policies, processes and practices at an India level.
* Transfers operational knowledge and skills to line management within your scope.
* Ensure key processes are managed and executed well and transactional tasks are executed timely.
* Partner with the recruitment team on hiring within your scope of businesses and participate in the interview process for selected roles.
* Ensure smooth onboarding for selected roles.
* Keep an active check on the attrition by analyzing the attrition data at regular intervals and identify retention strategies based on the analysis.
* Roll out employee engagement surveys at regular intervals, review and prepare insights on employee engagement and prepare an action plan along with the line management within your scope.

**What you’ll bring:**  

* 5\-8 years of experience in HR team in an international company
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field (HR, OB, Psychology)
* Ability to work on multiple projects with strong communication skills and experience working with multiple stakeholder groups.
* Highly disciplined and motivated: a self\-starter who is able to both work independently and as a member of the team
* Motivated and happy to work in a fast paced environment
* Able to navigate ambiguities and drive for process improvement
* Constantly demonstrates ownership and proactiveness in seeking to improve and optimize in anything related to their and their team’s work.

 **About BKNG**
Booking Holdings is the world leader in online travel \& related services. Our teams work around the clock to build and improve the technology that empowers people to more freely travel across borders, time zones, languages and cultures. At Booking Holdings, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world every day through seamless technology powered by our six major brands:  

 Booking.com
 KAYAK
 priceline

title: Technical Recruiter – Global Hiring (Remote, India)
description:
We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven **Technical Recruiter** to join our Human Resources team. This role will be supporting our Engineering and Service teams in Canada, USA and globally. This role offers an exciting opportunity to manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes, working both independently and as part of a collaborative team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of global hiring practices, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.  

  

The ideal candidate has experience recruiting for technical positions and is comfortable working across time zones to support hiring needs in Canada and the U.S.  

  

**About Evertz**  

Evertz India is the subsidy of Evertz Microsystems (TSX:ET) is a leading global manufacturer of broadcast equipment and solutions that deliver content to television sets, on\-demand services, WebTV, IPTV, and mobile devices (like phones and tablets). Evertz has expertise in delivering complete end\-to\-end broadcast solutions for all aspects of broadcast production including content creation, content distribution and content delivery. Considered as an innovator by their customers, Evertz delivers cutting edge solutions that are unmatched in the industry in both hardware and software. Evertz delivers products and solutions that can be found in major broadcast facilities on every continent. Evertz’ customer base also includes telcos, satellite, cable TV, and IPTV providers. With over 2000 employees, that include hardware and software engineers, Evertz is one of the leaders in the broadcast industry. Evertz has a global presence with offices located in: Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, United Arab Emirates, India, Hong Kong, China, Singapore, and Australia. Evertz was named one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies, which recognizes excellence in Canadian\-owned and Canadian\-managed companies.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct full\-cycle recruitment for Engineering and Service positions based in Canada, USA and globally.
* Maintain job board postings, screening applicants and hiring potential candidates
* Advertise \& brand of our vacancies in external job boards
* Source candidates through job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other recruitment channels
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate interviews to assess qualifications and fit
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain candidate records and track recruitment activity in the applicant tracking system
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles
* Work closely with HR and hiring managers to understand job requirements and recruitment priorities
* Ensure positive and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Assist with recruitment reporting and talent pipeline development
* Assist in full\-cycle Internship recruitment – post positions, interview, schedule interviews for hiring managers and extend offer
* Conducting job and task analyses to document job duties and requirements
* Updating applicant database, recruitment trackers and generate reports

  

**Must Haves:*** Post\-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5 years of recruitment experience recruiting for technical or engineering roles
* Must be able to work Monday to Friday 7:00 PM to 3:30 AM
* Experience supporting recruitment for North American markets (Canada and/or the United States) is an asset
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate to candidates in the North American market
* Strong understanding of sourcing techniques and recruitment platforms
* Ability to work collaboratively with teams across different time zones.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open roles.

  

**Key Competencies:*** Self\-motivated and able to work independently
* Candidate sourcing and screening
* Communication and relationship building
* Organization and attention to detail
* Time management and ability to meet hiring timelines
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced recruitment environment

  

Office Timings: Monday to Friday 7:00 PM to 3:30 AM IST
  

Work Model: Remote  

Office Location: India  

  

**Your Growth**  

At Evertz, we believe a career should be more than just a job, it should be a journey of growth, learning, and achievement. We provide mentorship, resources, and opportunities to help you explore your potential, take on challenges, and reach your goals. With ambitious plans to expand globally and deliver cutting\-edge broadcasting experiences, you will be part of a team where your talent is valued, your contributions matter, and your well\-being is supported every step of the way.  

A place where you are empowered to do great work and can benefit from,
* Flexible working hours and work from home opportunities
* Inhouse knowledge and product training
* Exposure to global broadcast platforms
* Performance\-related bonuses.
* Insurance and medical plans.
* Employee friendly leave policy

​We are looking for a versatile and disciplined **HR \& Admin Executive** to join our Fintech team in **Coimbatore**. This is a **Full\-Time, In\-Office** position for a professional with **2 to 4 years of experience** in a similar fast\-paced environment. You will be the backbone of our office operations, managing everything from talent acquisition and payroll to office administration and business development support.

​**Key Responsibilities**

​**1\. Human Resources \& People Operations**

* ​Manage the full recruitment cycle: Sourcing, screening, and interviewing for technical and financial roles.
* ​Handle all joining formalities, employee onboarding, and exit processes.
* ​Maintain a 100% accurate and up\-to\-date employee database (digital and physical).
* ​Perform monthly salary calculations, attendance tracking, and leave management.
* ​Draft, implement, and enforce company policies including code of conduct and statutory compliances.

​**2\. Office Administration \& Documentation**

* ​Prepare, send, and track professional agreements, NDAs, and offer letters.
* ​Manage office facility vendors (AMC, stationery, internet, and maintenance) and process invoices.
* ​Maintain high standards of data governance and systematic filing of corporate documents.
* ​Ensure the daily smooth functioning of the office premises.

​**3\. Business Development Support**

* ​Assist the leadership team with lead generation and market research within the Fintech/Investment sector.
* ​Handle initial outreach to potential business partners or clients.
* ​Assist in preparing professional pitch decks and business proposals.

​**Candidate Requirements**

* ​**Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven experience in an HR and Administrative role (Fintech, Banking, or Startup background is a major plus).
* ​**Education:** Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (MBA in HR or Operations is preferred).
* ​**Communication:** Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is essential. Proficiency in Tamil for local coordination is required.
* ​**Technical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in MS Office (specifically Excel for salary calculations) and familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter or HRMS tools.
* ​**Work Mode:** This is a strictly in\-office, full\-time role. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to Coimbatore.
* ​**Attributes:** Strong negotiation skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to maintain office discipline.

​**Why Join Us?**

​You will play a critical role in a growing Fintech company, gaining exposure to both people management and the strategic business side of the industry.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹46,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

title: HRMS & Systems Coordinator
description:
**JOB OVERVIEW** 




  





 The HRMS Coordinator is responsible for the technical administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization’s Human Resource Management System (HRMS). This role acts as the system owner for day\-to\-day HR technology operations, ensuring system stability, data integrity, integrations, reporting accuracy, and compliance.
 







 The position requires strong technical acumen, advanced data management skills, and the ability to collaborate with HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors to drive system efficiency and automation.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





**HRMS Technical Administration** 



* Administer and maintain the HRMS platform, ensuring system availability and optimal performance.
* Configure system modules, workflows, business rules, approval hierarchies, templates, and access controls.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and security profiles in line with data governance policies.
* Perform mass data uploads, data corrections, and system updates using advanced Excel tools.
* Maintain system documentation, configuration logs, and change management records.



  





**System Configuration \& Enhancements** 



* Lead configuration changes, structured releases, and continuous system enhancements.
* Translate business requirements into technical HRMS solutions.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and system validations.
* Coordinate with vendors and IT teams for upgrades, patches, and new module implementations.
* Support system integrations with payroll, ATS, finance systems, and other third\-party tools via APIs or data interfaces.



  





**Data Management \& Reporting** 



* Ensure high standards of data integrity, accuracy, and system governance.
* Conduct periodic data audits and reconciliation exercises.
* Develop and maintain standard and ad\-hoc HR reports.
* Create dashboards and HR analytics reports (headcount, attrition, leave, compensation data).
* Support payroll processing through system\-based data validation and extraction.
* Optimize reporting capabilities using advanced Excel functions (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, etc.)



  





**Compliance \& Data Security** 



* Ensure compliance with GDPR and applicable local data protection regulations.
* Maintain audit trails, system logs, and secure data storage protocols.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR data and system controls.
* Monitor and enforce role\-based access controls and segregation of duties.



  





**Process Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to improve HRMS processes and automation.
* Create SOPs and user guides for HRMS processes.
* Provide training to HR users and managers on system functionality.



  





  





**ABOUT YOU** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in HRMS administration or HR technology support.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Darwin box, or similar platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, basic macros preferred).
* Experience with system integrations, APIs, or data migration projects is an advantage.
* Understanding of payroll data structures and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with HR, IT, and vendors.



  





**ABOUT US** 




  





 Study Group is a leading international education provider that is dedicated and passionate about helping students around the world, creating a brighter future and reaching their full potential. With university partnerships and a variety of face\-to\-face, online, and hybrid study programmes, we are able to provide students with the resources and guidance they need to succeed. Our global network of offices and university partnerships ensure that students receive the best educational services available. Additionally, our Insendi platform enables us to deliver innovative, accessible, and intuitive digital learning experiences with the most advanced digital tools available.
 



  





**ORGANISATIONAL COMPLIANCE** 




  





 Study Group is proud of its high standards in safeguarding and recognises its importance in enabling the best possible student experience and outcomes. For successful applicants, the following checks will be conducted\- Criminal Background Check (country\-specific), x2 References, ID and Right to Work checks as well as Education Verification.
 



 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other factor. We believe that the best person for the job should be selected based on skills and experience alone. Your information will be kept confidential and stored securely. Please see our
 
 Privacy Policy
 
 .

description:
**About the Role:**  

**Grade Level (for internal use):** 07
  
**The Role:** Data Analyst
  
  

**The Team:**  

Estimates – The team provides highest quality content of Consensus Estimates, Actuals and Guidance information that is essential for our clients to make decisions with conviction. The team works on various research reports and company documents and collect information for forecasted and actual numbers and generate meaningful consensus from collected data. The team consists of 420\+ people working from offices in Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, and Manilla.
  
  

**The Impact:**  

We provide highest quality content that is essential for our clients to make decisions with conviction . As a Data Analyst, you will support the integrity and comprehensiveness of the data set by utilizing internal \& external public research sources such as government \& regulatory documents, stock exchanges, industry journals, analyst reports and our internal research tools to collect, summarize, and synthesize relevant information.
  
  

**What’s in it for you:**  

With exciting learning opportunities at its core, we'll help you focus on building the essential skills needed for a successful and meaningful transition into the professional world.
  
This position is an excellent steppingstone to understand the global market dynamism, that will allow you to gain a comprehensive understanding of the market and enable you to learn the various facets of the assigned industry. Once strong fundamental understanding of the dataset and proficiency at workflows is developed, this role would require working with new talent to develop/enhance your skillset and working on process improvement projects.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

High quality data (Financial) collation, analysis, extraction and entering the data in work tools as per guideline specifications for assigned vertical.
  
Understand the working of the dataset, be aware of the workflows and have strong working knowledge of work tools.
  
Providing input and ideas for new collection methods and product enhancements related to the dataset.
  
Deliver on predefined individual and team targets including delivering outcomes with quality and excellence.
  
Troubleshoots problems or issues and support team in enhancing the workflow/processes for department.
  
Reviewing feedback involving transactions content to help correct errors and establish or refine procedures and processes to improve accuracy.
  
  

**What We’re Looking For:**  

Graduate in B. Com / BBA OR Postgraduate /MBA (Finance as major Specialization) fresher candidates with good academic track record.
  
Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
  
Knowledge of corporate finance / accountancy i.e., financial statements and annual reports.
  
Well versed with secondary research sources.
  
Adaptability to work across all time\-zones.
  
Certification or knowledge/experience in MS\-office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  
Strong quantitative, analytical, and interpretive skills.
  
Ability to conduct efficient thematic online research.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

title: Junior Software Tester
description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Tester to support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities across application modules. The role involves executing manual test scenarios based on business workflows, documenting results, logging defects, and supporting retesting to ensure stable and production\-ready releases.


The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA teams during UAT cycles.


Roles \& Responsibilities


* Understand user stories and acceptance criteria and convert them into test scenarios.
* Execute UAT test cases based on real business workflows.
* Document test results clearly with supporting evidence such as screenshots or recordings.
* Update test execution status in test management tools.
* Maintain traceability between test cases and user stories.
* Log defects with proper details including:
* Steps to reproduce
* Expected vs Actual results
* Supporting evidence
* Support retesting after bug fixes.
* Perform basic regression testing for impacted modules.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA teams to ensure smooth UAT cycles.
* Ensure applications are stable and ready for production releases.


Job SpecificationsRequired Skills


* Basic understanding of Manual Testing.
* Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Ability to analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios.
* Strong attention to detail and logical thinking.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Willingness to learn and work in a collaborative team environment.


Good to Have


* Exposure to testing mobile applications (Android / iOS) or web applications.
* Basic knowledge of API testing using Postman.
* Basic understanding of SQL validation.
* Internship or academic project experience in software testing.
* Familiarity with booking, payments, wallet, or invoice workflows.


Experience


* 0–2 years of experience in Manual Testing / UAT Testing.
* Freshers can apply if they have a strong understanding of testing fundamentals.


Qualification


* BE / BTech – Computer Science / IT / ECE
* BSc / MSc – Computer Science / IT
* Software Testing Certification is an added advantage.

description:
**Job Title: Design Engineer cum Draftsman (Fabrication/Pressure Vessel)**

**Job Summary:**  
The Design Engineer cum Draftsman will be responsible for end\-to\-end design, modeling, and detailed drafting of pressure vessels, storage tanks, ISO containers, and process equipment. The role combines mechanical design calculation capabilities with drafting skills (2D/3D) to create fabrication\-ready drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), and cutting layouts that comply with international codes (ASME, API, etc.) and customer specifications.

**Key Responsibilities \& Duties**

* **Design \& Engineering Calculations:** Perform design calculations for pressure vessels, storage tanks, and containers according to ASME Section VIII Div. 1, API 650/620, or equivalent standards.
* **Drafting \& Modelling:** Create comprehensive 2D fabrication drawings and 3D models (GA drawings, structural, and detailed components) using AutoCAD and 3D software (SolidWorks).
* **Fabrication Detailing:** Develop detailed fabrication drawings, including nozzle orientation, manways, reinforcement details, internals/externals, ladders, and platforms.
* **Material Take\-off \& BOM:** Prepare Bill of Materials (BOM) and cutting layouts/nesting for optimal material utilization, including plates, pipes, and fittings.
* **Customer Specifications:** Review technical data sheets, tender documents, and client specifications to provide technical clarifications and deviations.
* **Project Support:** Coordinate with the production, QC, and procurement teams to resolve technical issues on the shop floor.
* **Quality Assurance:** Ensure all designs and drawings comply with industry standards (ASME, EN 1090\) and internal quality manuals.
* **As\-Built Drawings:** Prepare "As\-Built" drawings upon completion of the project.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 3–7 years of experience in designing and detailing pressure vessels, storage tanks, and containers in a fabrication industry setting.
* **Software Proficiency:** Highly proficient in AutoCAD (2D) and 3D modeling software (SolidWorks).
* **Code Knowledge:** Strong working knowledge of ASME Section VIII (Div 1 \& 2\), API 650, API 620, TEMA, or PD 5500\.
* **Technical Skills:** Knowledge of weld joint configurations, NDT (Non\-Destructive Testing) methods, and material specifications (SA240, SA516, etc.).
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients and shop floor personnel.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with PV Elite for vessel design.
* Experience in designing ISO containers or Specialized Tanks (DNV 2\.7\-1\).
* Understanding of CNC machine programming (for cutting machines). Suretank \+2

**Key Metrics for Success**

* **Approval Time:** Minimizing drawing revisions (Code\-1 approval).
* **Accuracy:** Zero error in fabrication drawings and BOM.
* **Material Utilization:** Optimizing plate/pipe cutting layout to reduce waste

------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

title: Trade Operations Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.  

  

We connect the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to roughly 90% of world trade flows providing a powerful mix of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new growth opportunities. We are innovative problem solvers that provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We solve business challenges through growth, disruption, or uncertainty, and we bring clients insights and ideas to enable grow and protect their business.  

  

Our comprehensive suite of products and services can be combined into global solutions that help make it easier for businesses to manage trade risk, process trade transactions, and fund trade activities.

  

We are currently seeking applications to join the \< HSBC, Global Trade Solutions \- Receivable Finance Services \> team.

 **Job Introduction**


This role belongs to the operations job family, and the role holder would be working in the Receivable Finance operations unit based out of Mumbai, India. This unit supports the trade working capital; supply chain \& structured trade finance pan India operations for the Global Trade Solutions business which is an integral part of the Corporate \& Institutional Banking customer group.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

The role holder (RF Operations Associate) would provide support to the operations unit supporting the Receivables Finance business.

* Perform core transactions processing in compliance with the DIMs, GOPs and Bank’s policies
* Support the service operations team or unit in the operation, delivery and execution of internal business services
* Ensure a high level of operational efficiency in Receivable Finance operations.
* Scrutinize transaction documents to ensure approval conditions are met and documents are genuine
* Ensure operational controls are maintained and adhered to by following all the group guidelines / policies, Internal Controls and all relevant external regulations.
* Ensure Transactions and repayments are processed in timely and error free manner ensuring no operational losses and adhering to all controls.
* Co\-ordinate with IT support team on system upgrade, change control release and resolution of problems encountered.

 **Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Strong organizing and time management skills.
* Strong interpersonal, influencing and communication skills.
* A good team player who possesses good interpersonal and communication skills
* Good command of spoken and written English desirable.
* A bachelor’s degree preferably in a business or related area. Freshers may apply.

  



You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Founded in Manhattan, New York, with additional offices in Charlotte, North Carolina (US), and Mumbai, India, Houzeo is led by our founder, Amit Dhameja. With an Ivy League MBA and a background in finance, real estate, and tech, Mr. Dhameja spearheads this profitable startup.

**The Houzeo Universe**

● Houzeo IntelliList Listing: This tool auto\-assigns the right paperwork for a seller’s property based on location. It’s the fastest way to list a home!  
● Houzeo Showings: A digital showing scheduling app designed for sellers. Buyers and agents can directly request showings once a seller verifies them!  
● Houzeo Offers: An offer management tool to evaluate, compare and counter offers received on a property.

● Houzeo DigiTransact: DigiTransact lets sellers maneuver the real estate transaction with milestones, tasks, notifications and reminders seamlessly. No more friction!

title: Audit & Accounts Assistant- Fresh
description:
Chartered Accountant Firm – Professional Career Opportunity  
Anna Nagar West, Chennai \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site

We are a partner\-led Chartered Accountant firm with more than 25 years of professional practice, serving clients across accounting, audit, taxation, and regulatory advisory. Our firm has been built on consistency, professional discipline, and long\-term client relationships.

Unlike many offices that operate with only routine work allocation, our firm focuses strongly on professional learning and hands\-on exposure under direct Chartered Accountant supervision. We believe that strong fundamentals in accounting, taxation, and compliance are developed through structured learning and practical experience.

Many professionals who started their careers with us as trainees have grown into responsible roles handling clients independently. We aim to build a team of professionals who develop their careers with the firm over the long term.

This opportunity is intended for candidates who are interested in building solid professional knowledge and practical experience rather than looking for short\-term job changes.

**Who Should Apply**

Candidates who value learning and professional development  
Individuals who prefer structured and disciplined work environments  
Candidates willing to take responsibility and grow gradually  
Professionals interested in long\-term career stability  
Candidates residing within reasonable commuting distance to Anna Nagar West, Chennai will be preferred, as long daily travel can affect consistency and learning continuity.

**Open Role**

Accounts \& Audit Trainee – Freshers / Articleship Exposure

This position is designed as a learning\-oriented role where candidates will receive direct practical exposure to multiple areas of Chartered Accountancy practice.

**Areas of Learning and Exposure**

Accounting and financial statement preparation  
GST registration, return filing and compliance  
Income tax return filing and tax compliance support  
GST and Income tax notice handling support  
Audit assistance including preparation of audit working papers  
Statutory compliance work including ROC related support  
Client documentation, record management and compliance tracking  
Practical understanding of business transactions and accounting systems

Our office emphasizes learning the correct process before performing the work independently. Trainees are guided step by step to understand why a task is performed, not just how it is done. This approach helps build strong professional confidence and long\-term capability.

Candidates will also receive direct interaction and guidance from the Chartered Accountant, providing valuable real\-world experience that is difficult to obtain in larger, highly segmented offices.

**What We Expect from Candidates**

Discipline and reliability  
Strong willingness to learn  
Professional communication and attitude  
Consistency and responsibility in assigned work  
Commitment to long\-term professional growth

**Compensation**

₹8,000 – ₹10,000 per month initially, with structured salary progression based on learning and performance.

**Career Progression**

Trainee  
Associate  
Senior Associate  
Client Handler / Independent Client Responsibility

**Work Structure**

Location: Anna Nagar West, Chennai  
Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

Our office follows planned workflows and professional systems to ensure a respectful, organized and productive working environment.

**Minimum Commitment**

Since this role involves structured training and continuous professional guidance, selected candidates will be required to enter into a minimum 3\-year service agreement with the firm. This ensures both the firm and the candidate benefit from the learning investment and long\-term career development.

**Application Process**

Please apply directly through Indeed with a complete and updated profile including contact number, location, and educational details.

Applicants should carefully answer the screening questions provided on the platform. Applications with incomplete responses may not be considered.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage and should be prepared to attend an in\-person interview at our Anna Nagar West office.

**Our Hiring Philosophy**

We hire selectively and invest time in developing our team members. Our goal is not simply to fill positions but to build professionals who grow with the firm.

Candidates who are interested in serious professional learning, stable career growth, and long\-term association with a Chartered Accountant practice will find this opportunity meaningful and rewarding.

If you are looking for a place where learning comes first, practical experience is guided directly by a Chartered Accountant, and professional growth happens step by step, we welcome your application

**4\. Continuous Improvement**

PLC Programmer – Job Description

**Job Title:** PLC Programmer  
**Department:** Automation / Electrical Engineering  
**Reports To:** Automation Manager / Project Manager

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled **PLC Programmer** to design, develop, test, and maintain programmable logic controller (PLC) systems used in industrial automation. The candidate will work closely with electrical engineers, technicians, and project teams to implement reliable automation solutions for manufacturing and industrial processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, program, and troubleshoot **PLC control systems** for industrial machines and processes.
* Design and modify **PLC logic, HMI screens, and SCADA systems**.
* Perform **system testing, debugging, and commissioning** of automation systems.
* Integrate PLCs with **sensors, motors, drives and other industrial equipment**.
* Read and interpret **electrical drawings, P\&IDs, and control diagrams**.
* Maintain and upgrade existing PLC programs to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Provide **technical support and troubleshooting** for production issues.
* Document programs, system configurations, and maintenance procedures.
* Work with cross\-functional teams during **installation and startup** of automation systems.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **PLC programming** (Ladder Logic, Function Block, Structured Text).
* Experience with PLC platforms such as:
* **Siemens (S7, TIA Portal)**
* **Allen Bradley (RSLogix / Studio 5000\)**
* Mitsubishi / Omron (optional depending on company).
* Experience with **HMI and SCADA systems**.
* Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols** (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, Profinet).
* Ability to read **electrical schematics and control panel drawings**.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Diploma in **Electrical Engineering / Automation Engineering / Mechatronics**.
* **2–5 years experience** in PLC programming or industrial automation (can adjust for junior/senior role).
* Experience with **machine commissioning and industrial automation projects** preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with **VFDs, servo systems, and robotics**.
* Knowledge of **industrial safety standards**.
* Experience in **manufacturing or process industries**.

Work Environment

* Industrial / manufacturing environment.
* May require **travel for machine installation and commissioning**.

Salary

* Based on **experience and skill level**.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund

title: Creative Content Creator & Social Media Manager
description:
**Location: Mumbai (On\-site / In\-person)**

We are looking for a highly proactive Content Creator and Social Media Manager to join our team in Mumbai. We manage a diverse portfolio of brands—ranging from high\-end jewellery to toys, a bustling pet store, and a general retail destination.

We don't need a robot who just hits "post." We need a visual storyteller who lives and breathes online trends, knows exactly how to frame a shot, and has the enthusiasm to bring each of our unique brands to life every single day. This is a full\-time, in\-person role; you must be based in Mumbai and ready to be on\-site to film and create.

**The Gig: What You’ll Do**

Ideation \& Strategy: Brainstorm and plan content calendars for four distinct brands. You’ll be the architect of our social presence.

Production: Get behind the camera. You’ll be filming content (reels, TikToks, product showcases) that looks professional, polished, and aesthetic.

Post\-Production: Edit your footage into scroll\-stopping short\-form video content. (Bonus points for great transitions and pacing).

Community Management: Own the daily rhythm. Post consistently across all channels, write engaging captions, and keep the community active.

Trend Hunting: Keep a pulse on current trends, sounds, and memes, and adapt them quickly to fit our specific brand voices.

**The Must\-Haves**

Organic Growth Experience: Have you successfully grown a social media account from scratch using organic strategies? Tell us your story. Candidates with proven experience in community building and viral organic growth are our dream applicants.

A "Visual First" Eye: You understand composition, lighting, and what makes a video look premium vs. amateur.

Versatility: Can you pivot from the elegant vibe of a jewellery brand to the playful energy of a toy store? You must be able to switch brand "tones" instantly.

Proactive Energy: You don’t wait for instructions. You see an opportunity for content and you make it happen.

The Tech Stack: Proficiency in mobile video editing tools (e.g., CapCut, Premiere Rush, or similar) is essential.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

No Boredom: You aren’t stuck in one niche. One day you’re filming a diamond necklace; the next, you’re creating content for a new toy drop.

Creative Autonomy: We want your ideas. If you see a trend that works for us, we want you to run with it.

High Impact: You will see the direct results of your creative work in our engagement and growth.

**How to Apply**

Please send us your portfolio/reel of work that showcases your filming and editing style (**email: houseofmaashee@gmail.com**). Crucially: In your application, please highlight any specific accounts you have grown organically. If you have a specific video you've made that you are particularly proud of, include that too!

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

description:

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and self\-driven Marketing Intern who can independently manage and execute the overall marketing function. This role requires a strong understanding of both traditional and digital marketing, combined with the ability to plan, implement, and monitor marketing activities end\-to\-end.

The ideal candidate will take full ownership of marketing initiatives, coordinate with internal teams, and drive brand visibility, lead generation, and marketing performance with minimal supervision.

* Collaborate with sales, product, and leadership teams to align marketing initiatives with business goals.

**2\. Digital Marketing (Part of the Role)**

PPC \& Lead Generation

* Track performance metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, conversions, ROI) and refine campaigns.

**6\. Market Research \& Data Managemen**t

* Prepare scraping data and market intelligence reports.
* Support management with MIS and performance dashboards.

**7\. Performance Analysis \& Reporting**

* Monitor marketing KPIs across both digital and offline activities.
* Prepare regular performance reports with insights and improvement suggestions.
* Conduct A/B tests and track results for continuous optimisation.

* Excellent communication, planning, and coordination skills.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing (PPC, SEO, analytics).
* Ability to independently manage marketing activities with high ownership.
* Proficiency in tools: Google Ads, Analytics, Search Console, MS Office, CRM systems.
* Understanding of website platforms (WordPress, CMS tools).
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Desirable Skills:

* Experience with LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram marketing.
* Knowledge of email marketing tools or automation platforms.
* Creative thinking and copywriting ability.
* Google certifications are an added advantage.

Qualifications:

* Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, IT, or a related field.

**Stipend \- 10k**

description:
**Role Purpose**

The Business Development Manager (BDM) is responsible for driving regional business growth by managing assigned districts and supervising Territory Managers, Team Leaders, and Field Sales Officers (FOS). The role focuses on achieving merchant acquisition, activation, and productivity targets across **QR deployment, Soundbox installations, and Fintech services**, while ensuring quality merchant onboarding, strong activation rates, and sustainable regional business expansion.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Business Target Achievement \& Territory Planning**

* Convert state\-level targets into **regional and district\-level business plans** for QR codes, Soundbox devices, and fintech product acquisition.
* Develop and implement **territory coverage strategies**, including weekly beat plans, town coverage, and rural cluster mapping.
* Allocate and deploy Field Sales Officers (FOS) efficiently across markets to maximize merchant acquisition and activation.
* Track target achievement regularly and implement **corrective action plans** to ensure timely delivery of business goals.

**2\. Team Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead and supervise **Territory Managers (TM), Team Leaders (TL), and Field Sales Officers (FOS)** in the assigned region.
* Ensure adequate team strength, productivity, and professional conduct across field operations.
* Conduct **joint field visits** with team members to evaluate merchant engagement quality and improve sales effectiveness.
* Organize regular **training sessions** on product knowledge, merchant onboarding processes, fintech solutions, and sales strategies.

**3\. Performance Monitoring \& Productivity Enhancement**

* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics, including:
* Merchant acquisition per FOS
* Points per FOS productivity
* Soundbox installation targets
* Fintech product onboarding
* Identify performance gaps where productivity falls below benchmarks (e.g., **250 points per FOS or less than 15 Soundbox installations per month**).
* Introduce **regional incentive programs, competitions, and productivity campaigns** to motivate teams and enhance performance.

**4\. Market Expansion \& Merchant Acquisition**

* Identify high\-potential merchant segments such as:
* Retail and large kirana stores
* Fuel stations
* Hospitals and medical facilities
* Hotels, restaurants, and hospitality outlets
* Transport hubs, mandis, and wholesale markets
* Plan **targeted merchant acquisition drives** and regional campaigns to expand QR and Soundbox adoption.
* Strengthen the regional merchant network to increase fintech product usage and transaction volumes.

**5\. Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights**

* Track competitor activities in the region, including **QR installations, Soundbox deployments, and fintech offerings**.
* Monitor competitor pricing, promotional campaigns, and merchant engagement strategies.
* Recommend tactical responses such as **special schemes, branding initiatives, and service improvements** to maintain market leadership.

**6\. Merchant Activation, Quality \& Service Management**

* Ensure all onboarded merchants are properly **activated and operational**, including device installation and application login.
* Monitor merchant activity indicators such as **minimum GMV generation and active device usage**.
* Coordinate with operations and technical teams to **resolve merchant issues quickly**, including device replacement, settlement queries, and technical support.

**7\. Reporting, MIS \& Strategic Coordination**

* Prepare and submit **regional MIS and performance reports**, including:
* Productivity per FOS, TL, and TM
* Merchant acquisition statistics
* Cost per acquisition
* Regional revenue and profitability analysis
* Implement directives issued by the **State Head and central management teams**.
* Provide feedback and insights from field operations to improve fintech products, merchant services, and operational processes.

description:
**Job Type:** Full\-time, (1\-Year Apprenticeship)  
**Stipend:** 18000 Per Month

**About the Program**

We are looking for energetic and motivated fresh graduates/diploma holders to join our **National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)** program. This is a government\-authorized 1\-year on\-the\-job training (OJT) designed to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and industrial practice. Upon successful completion, you will receive a **Certificate of Proficiency** from the Government of India, which is recognized as one year of work experience.  
**Key Responsibilities**

As a Production Trainee, you will work on the shop floor under the guidance of senior engineers. Your daily tasks will include:

* **Machine Operation:** Learning to operate and monitor production machinery and automated systems safely.
* **Assembly \& Processing:** Assisting in the manual or mechanical assembly of components as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Quality Checks:** Conducting basic quality inspections of raw materials and finished goods to ensure they meet company standards.
* **Documentation:** Maintaining daily production logs, shift reports, and 5S checklists.
* **Safety Compliance:** Strict adherence to shop floor safety protocols, including the mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* **Process Improvement:** Participating in Kaizen or Lean manufacturing initiatives to reduce wastage and improve efficiency.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in **Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Automobile Engineering**.
* **Year of Passing:** 2020 \- 2026 only.
* Must have the **Provisional Certificate,**
* **Experience:** Strictly for **Freshers**. Candidates with prior apprenticeship or more than 1 year of work experience are not eligible.
* **Age:** Minimum 18 years

**Benefits**

* **Stipend:** Competitive monthly stipend (including Govt. DBT share).
* **Certification:** Govt. of India recognized Experience Certificate.
* **Training:** Hands\-on experience with modern industrial tools and technology.
* **Facilities:** Canteen , Transport , Uniform , Insurance .
