title: Network Engineer
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a qualified Network Engineer with expertise in Aruba and Juniper networking solutions to provide onsite manpower support as a resident engineer at our client site in Hyderabad. The selected candidate will be responsible for network monitoring, administration, and security device management, ensuring the optimal performance and availability of all network infrastructure.
 



**Mandatory Qualifications** 




**Educational Requirements:** 



* Diploma or BE/B.Tech in Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Computer Science Engineering (CSE) from a recognized educational institute



**Experience:** 



* Minimum 3 to 4 years of relevant work experience in network administration and support
* **Hands\-on experience with Aruba networking products (switches, wireless controllers, access points)**
* **Hands\-on experience with Juniper networking equipment (switches, routers, firewalls)**



**Certifications (Mandatory):** 



* Valid CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) certification or equivalent networking certification
* **Aruba certification (ACSA/ACMA/ACMP) OR Juniper certification (JNCIA/JNCIS or higher) \- Required**



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Network Monitoring \& Management** 



* Conduct daily monitoring of the health status of all network devices including Aruba switches, Juniper switches/routers, and other network appliances
* Monitor network connectivity and performance across Aruba and Juniper infrastructure
* Ensure optimal network uptime and performance through proactive monitoring
* Perform continuous monitoring of network logs and system alerts from Aruba and Juniper devices



**Network Configuration \& Administration** 



* Configure and reconfigure Aruba switches, wireless controllers, and access points
* Configure and manage Juniper switches, routers, and network devices
* Configure and manage NGFW (Next\-Generation Firewall), WAF (Web Application Firewall), AAA servers, and EMS (Element Management System)
* Implement VLANs, routing protocols, and network segmentation on Aruba and Juniper platforms
* Take regular configuration backups for all network and security devices
* Maintain accurate network configuration documentation and topology diagrams



**Troubleshooting \& Technical Support** 



* Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity issues on Aruba and Juniper equipment
* Diagnose and fix performance issues related to Aruba wireless infrastructure
* Troubleshoot routing and switching issues on Juniper devices
* Address security incidents affecting network operations
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities in network and security devices
* Apply software patches, firmware updates, and JunOS/ArubaOS upgrades to all network devices
* Log support calls with Aruba, Juniper, and other OEMs for hardware repairs and faulty component replacement
* Coordinate with vendors for RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processes and technical support escalations



**Network Operations \& Maintenance** 



* Maintain network logs and system logs from Aruba ClearPass, Juniper devices, and other systems in accordance with operational requirements
* Ensure proper log retention as per cybersecurity and compliance standards
* Move log backups to designated storage systems as needed
* Generate network performance reports and status updates
* Provide timely alerts and notifications to management regarding network issues and critical alarms



**Backup \& Documentation** 



* Take regular configuration backups of all Aruba and Juniper devices
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of network changes, incidents, and resolutions
* Document standard operating procedures for Aruba and Juniper network operations



**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Skills:** 



* **Strong hands\-on experience with Aruba switching and wireless solutions**
* **Proficiency in Juniper Networks equipment including JunOS configuration and management**
* In\-depth knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, LACP, etc.)
* Experience with Aruba ClearPass for network access control and AAA services
* Knowledge of Juniper EX/QFX series switches and SRX series firewalls
* Familiarity with Aruba AirWave or Central for wireless network management
* Experience with Aruba Mobility Controllers and Instant Access Points
* Understanding of Juniper Space and network management tools
* Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls (NGFW), WAF, and network security devices
* Experience with network monitoring tools and log management systems
* Understanding of network troubleshooting methodologies and diagnostic tools
* Familiarity with patch management and firmware upgrade processes
* Experience with network backup solutions and configuration management



**Professional Skills:** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with focus on Aruba and Juniper platforms
* Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for multi\-vendor environments
* Effective communication skills for coordinating with Aruba, Juniper, and other vendors
* Ability to work independently and handle day\-to\-day operations with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail and methodical approach to network administration
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively
* Customer service orientation with ability to work in client\-facing environment
* Quick learner with ability to adapt to new technologies and platforms



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Both Aruba and Juniper certifications (holding certifications from both vendors is highly desirable)
* Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP) or Aruba Certified Switching Professional (ACSP)
* Juniper Networks Certified Specialist (JNCIS) or higher level certifications
* Experience with Aruba Fabric Composer (AFC) or Virtual Switching Framework (VSF)
* Knowledge of Juniper Virtual Chassis and EVPN\-VXLAN architectures
* Experience with SD\-WAN solutions from Aruba or Juniper
* Experience working in large enterprise or data center environments



**Working Conditions** 



* This is an onsite position requiring daily presence at the client location in Hyderabad
* Regular day shift operations (Monday to Friday)
* May require occasional extended hours during network maintenance windows or critical incidents
* Direct coordination with client IT teams and external vendors (Aruba, Juniper, etc.)



**What We Offer** 



* Full\-time employment with career stability and growth opportunities
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise\-level Aruba and Juniper networking infrastructure
* Opportunity to work with advanced network technologies and security devices
* Professional development and networking skill enhancement with industry\-leading platforms
* Exposure to large\-scale network operations and management
* Opportunity to enhance expertise in Aruba and Juniper technologies
* Competitive compensation and benefits package



**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates meeting the above requirements should submit their updated resume along with:
 


* Copies of educational certificates (Diploma/BE/B.Tech)
* Valid CCNA or equivalent certification
* **Valid Aruba OR Juniper certification (mandatory)**
* Detailed work experience summary highlighting relevant Aruba and Juniper projects (minimum 3\-4 years)
* Brief description of hands\-on experience with Aruba and Juniper equipment

 The
 **Senior Technical Writer** 
 is responsible for managing the publication and translation of product labeling for Cepheid’s Xpert tests and GeneXpert instrument systems. The associate will have an opportunity to partner with Regulatory Affairs and collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Product Transfer, R\&D, Hardware/Software Engineers, Clinical) to create, edit, format, and publish primary labeling (e.g., Instructions for Use (IFUs), Quick Reference Instructions (QRIs), Operator’s Manuals/User’s Guide, and Getting Started Guide) for Cepheid’s menu of in vitro diagnostic products.
   

  

 This is an on\-site position within the Technical Publications team structured under Cepheid’s – Post Launch Sustainment organization located at our India Development Center in Bangalore, India. At Cepheid, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Develop, edit, and publish clear, accurate Instructions for Use (IFUs), Quick Reference Instructions, and other regulatory\-compliant documents for Cepheid’s Xpert tests.
* Manage the end\-to\-end creation of documentation, including operator’s manuals, user guides, getting started guides, and service manuals for Cepheid’s instrument systems.
* Drive quality and consistency by reviewing and peer\-reviewing publications for content accuracy, format, and adherence to Cepheid’s style guide.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) and cross\-functional teams to gather, verify, and validate technical information, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate translation requests with external suppliers, format post\-translation documents, and manage the release of final documentation in Cepheid’s system.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences with 6–12 years of technical writing experience in the biotech industry.
* Proficiency in XML/DITA CCMS, Adobe FrameMaker, Acrobat, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Microsoft Word, and ABBYY FineReader; experience developing DITA styling for online documentation.
* Strong command of English grammar, punctuation, and writing, with attention to detail, accuracy, and adherence to policies, procedures, and style guides.
* Experience participating in product development teams, creating and updating SOPs, and conducting verification and validation of technical publications.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills with the ability to prioritize, multi\-task, and work with focused urgency as required by project timelines.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* Proficiency in preparing images for technical documentation and modifying CSS for enhanced output styling.
* Experience in medical equipment writing and familiarity with Agile documentation systems.


 Cepheid, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at danaherbenefitsinfo.com.
   

  

 This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.
   

  

 We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Required: 3\-5 Yrs of experience in Python development with experience in building and operating production\-grade data acquisition and extraction systems
* Required: Strong hands\-on experience in at least one additional language (e.g., Java, C\#, Go, C\+\+, or Rust) to inform sound system design
* Required: Experience designing, deploying, and operating scalable and resilient pipelines with strong observability (monitoring, logging) and incident response practices
* Required: Strong engineering discipline in continuous integration/continuous delivery, automated testing, and production readiness. Proven ability to run software in a production cloud environment (e.g., AWS, Azure)
* Required: Proven ability to deliver iteratively on a regular cadence (for example, biweekly releases) and improve reliability and performance over time
* Preferred: Experience with web data acquisition, anti\-bot techniques, and processing unstructured content (for example, HTML, PDF, XML) into validated structured datasets
* Preferred: Experience integrating machine learning or large language model\-based extraction approaches into production workflows
* Preferred: Familiarity with Python async frameworks (asyncio) and web scraping tools (BeautifulSoup, Selenium/Playwright)
* Preferred: Experience with distributed processing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Airflow)


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**Responsibilities**
* Build and operate scalable web data acquisition and extraction pipelines, delivering high\-quality structured datasets from complex unstructured sources
* Design, build, and maintain production\-grade data acquisition pipelines for global regulatory and government sources
* Implement anti\-bot and resilience strategies (for example, proxy rotation, headless browser automation, and CAPTCHA handling) to improve crawl success and stability
* Build robust extraction workflows to process unstructured documents (for example, HTML, PDF, XML) into validated structured datasets
* Integrate acquisition outputs with downstream enrichment workflows to support tagging, linkage, classification, and dataset usability
* Deliver improvements and new production capabilities on a regular cadence (for example, every two weeks), including new sources, extraction enhancements, and reliability upgrades
* Establish and maintain continuous integration/continuous delivery practices, including automated testing, monitoring, and operational runbooks as needed
* Pilot and productionize at least one large language model\-based parsing workflow, improving extraction accuracy for complex document types
* Collaborate with machine learning engineers on prompt engineering and fine\-tuning initiatives to enhance metadata extraction and entity resolution
* Implement feedback mechanisms (for example, tracking interfaces or application programming interfaces) so downstream consumers can submit corrections and enhancements, and use that feedback to drive continuous quality improvement


**About The Team**
 Our Unstructured Data Team is responsible for building a cost\-efficient, fast, self\-service, controlled\-risk data acquisition and extraction platform at scale. Our team contributes to Moody’s by:
   

  

* Delivering high\-quality datasets from diverse web and regulatory sources to support strategic business and analytics use cases
* Improving data freshness, reliability, and enrichment to increase downstream decision\-making quality
* Advancing automation capabilities, including production integration of large language models to improve extraction and entity resolution


 By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in large\-scale web data acquisition, unstructured document processing, data pipeline engineering, and production AI\-assisted extraction across global source coverage.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: HR Manager
description:
**OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands\-on HR Manager to independently own the entire people function for a growing team operating across India and the UAE. This is not a corporate HR role — you will be building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a fast\-paced startup environment.

You will handle everything from recruiting and onboarding to payroll coordination, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, and exit management. We need someone who combines strong HR fundamentals with startup pragmatism — someone who can draft a proper employment contract AND have a tough conversation about performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and background verification. Execute structured onboarding with Day 1 checklists, tool access, policy walkthroughs, and 30\-day check\-ins.

**Payroll \& Compliance**

Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verification. Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, PT) and UAE labor law basics. Maintain audit\-ready employee records and documentation.

**Performance Management**

Implement review cycles: goal setting, check\-ins, and quarterly/annual reviews. Manage PIPs with proper documentation. Coordinate salary reviews and increments based on performance data.

**Employee Engagement**

Conduct monthly 1\-on\-1 check\-ins with all employees. Plan team activities and recognition programs. Manage grievances with confidentiality. Run quarterly engagement surveys.

**Policy \& Reporting**

Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR policies. Deliver monthly HR dashboards: headcount, attrition, open positions, payroll costs. Benchmark compensation against market data.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–7 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 1–2 years managing HR independently for a small company (10–50 employees).
* Hands\-on experience with Indian payroll, PF, ESI, and labor compliance.
* Proven recruitment experience: personally hired 15\+ employees across technical and non\-technical roles.
* Experience managing performance reviews, PIPs, and difficult employee conversations.
* Strong documentation skills: employment contracts, policies, and professional communications.
* Proficiency in HR tools (HRMS/HRIS) and Excel for payroll and reporting.
* Excellent English communication (written and verbal).
* High integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience with UAE labor law (MOHRE, WPS, visa processing).
* Experience in an IT services or SaaS startup environment.
* HR certification (SHRM\-CP, PHR, or Indian equivalent).
* Experience managing distributed/remote teams across countries.

title: HR & Admin Executive
description:
**About RAS Luxury Skincare**

RAS Luxury Skincare is a premium, science\-backed skincare brand rooted in the belief that real ingredients deliver real results. We are a lean, high\-performing team where every individual — including our founders — rolls up their sleeves and gets things done. Our culture is collaborative, ego\-free, and deeply invested in excellence at every level.

**Role Overview**

This is a one\-person powerhouse role. The Senior Executive – HR, Admin \& Operations is the backbone of the Mumbai office — responsible for keeping the workplace running seamlessly, building a great team, and ensuring every employee has a positive experience from Day 1\.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable writing a recruitment brief, onboarding a new joiner, resolving a laptop issue, and stepping in to make sure a cabin is set up correctly before an important meeting. At RAS, no task is beneath anyone — our founders and senior leadership lead by example in this regard, and we expect the same from this role.

**A Note on Culture \& Mindset**

At RAS, we believe that the best leaders are hands\-on. Whether it is our founders or a VP, no one considers any task too small if it serves the team or the brand. A few examples of what this looks like in practice:

On office \& operations: If the housekeeping staff has missed placing water glasses in a cabin before a meeting, our Senior Executive does not escalate or wait — they place the glasses themselves and then address the root cause with the housekeeper afterwards.

On recruitment: If a strong candidate has not heard back in three days and is likely to drop off, our Senior Executive does not wait for a reminder from the hiring manager — they pick up the phone, keep the candidate warm, and follow up internally to get a decision. A good candidate lost to slow process is a failure we take personally.

On onboarding: If a new joiner's laptop is not ready on Day 1, our Senior Executive does not shrug and say the IT vendor is delayed — they arrange an interim solution, sit with the joiner through their first\-day setup, and make sure the person feels genuinely welcomed, not just processed. First impressions of a company are set in the first 48 hours.

On making people feel secure: Employees should never feel like they are in the dark about where they stand. Our Senior Executive proactively checks in — especially with newer team members — to ensure they feel supported, heard, and clear on expectations. A settled, secure team performs better. That is not soft work; it is strategic.

On performance \& feedback: This role is also a trusted channel for the leadership team. If someone on the team is underperforming, struggling, or creating friction, our Senior Executive is expected to have honest, constructive conversations — both to support the individual and to keep leadership informed. This requires courage, tact, and complete confidentiality. It is not about managing people out; it is about helping people grow, and being clear when growth is not happening.

**This is not an exception; it is an expectation. If you bring ego to this role, this is not the right place for you. If you bring ownership, empathy, and the courage to do hard things well — you will thrive here.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

– Own end\-to\-end recruitment: write JDs, post on relevant platforms, source candidates, screen resumes

– Shortlist candidates based on role fitment and coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers

– Coordinate and confirm all interview logistics — in\-person and virtual

– Ensure timely follow\-up with candidates at every stage; maintain a positive candidate experience

– Collect structured interview feedback from the reporting manager within 24 hours of each interview

– Maintain a recruitment tracker and provide weekly status updates to leadership

– Build a pipeline of passive candidates for recurring roles

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

– Execute a structured, warm, and professional onboarding experience for every new joiner

– Prepare offer letters, employment documentation, and Day 1 readiness kits

– Coordinate system access, ID cards, workstation setup, and equipment allocation before the joining date

– Conduct the induction session covering company history, culture, values, team introductions, and policies

– Ensure the new joiner meets all key stakeholders in the first week

– Schedule 30\-day and 60\-day check\-ins and capture early feedback from both joiner and reporting manager

3\. Employee Welfare, Engagement \& Grievance Handling

– Be the go\-to person for employees with concerns, queries, or requests — approachable and discreet

– Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, and milestone events

– Maintain a calendar of birthdays, work anniversaries, and team events

– Handle grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality; escalate to leadership only when truly necessary

– Gather periodic pulse feedback from employees and share actionable insights with leadership

– Ensure HR policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied

4\. Scheduling \& Coordination

– Manage interview scheduling, induction calendars, and leadership meeting coordination

– Handle logistics for internal events, offsite meetings, and team gatherings

– Maintain accurate records: attendance, leave, HR documentation, vendor contracts

– Prepare and share regular reports on open positions, headcount, and admin status with leadership

5\. Administration \& Facility Management

– Ensure the Mumbai office is clean, well\-stocked, and fully operational at all times

– Manage housekeeping staff — set daily task schedules, conduct spot checks, and hold them accountable for quality

– Be the first line of response for any facility issue: if something is not right, fix it first and investigate second

– Manage vendor relationships: office supplies, pantry, maintenance, courier, utilities

– Maintain office inventory and raise purchase requests proactively — never let the office run out of essentials

– Coordinate asset allocation and maintenance (furniture, equipment, appliances)

– Ensure meeting rooms and cabins are set up correctly before every meeting — water, stationery, AV, cleanliness

6\. IT Support \& Coordination

– Be the first point of contact for day\-to\-day IT issues: connectivity, software access, hardware problems

– Coordinate with external IT vendors for resolution of issues that require specialised support

– Manage software licenses, tool subscriptions, and access management for the office

– Ensure all new joiners have fully configured systems and required software access on Day 1

– Maintain an asset register for all IT equipment and ensure timely servicing or replacement

Linux engineers play a key role in infrastructure automation, patching, incident response, and environment monitoring, serving as subject matter experts for open\-source platforms.

They typically work with distributions like Red Hat, Ubuntu, or CentOS and are skilled in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Perl. Linux engineers automate system provisioning and configuration using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet and frequently manage deployments across hybrid or cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Good communication and relationship\-building skills.
